plan: VISERON P2.3 — Production Server Migration Plan
target: UpCloud — AMD EPYC 7542 (32C/64T), 256GB RAM, Windows Server 2025 Standard

phases.name: PRE-MIGRATION (current laptop)
steps: Run npm test — verify all 67 tests pass
Run npm run lint — verify TypeScript compiles
Export .env for manual transfer (NOT in backup)
Run npm run backup — existing backup script
Copy backup to cloud storage or USB drive
Verify backup integrity: test extract on different machine

phases.name: TARGET SETUP (UpCloud server)
steps: Install Python 3.10+ (winget install python or from python.org)
Pull models: ollama pull qwen2.5:3b && ollama pull qwen2.5:7b
npm start — verify web server starts on port 32123
npm test — verify all 67 tests pass

phases.name: VALIDATION
steps: Verify Founder OS (npm run founder status)

phases.name: PRODUCTION HARDENING
steps: Set up Windows Firewall: allow ports 32123 (API), 11434 (Ollama)
Configure IIS/nginx reverse proxy if needed
Set up PM2 or Task Scheduler for auto-restart on boot
Update DNS to point trinnityviseronsystem.io to new server
SSL/TLS via Cloudflare or Let's Encrypt

rollbackPlan: Old laptop remains operational during migration. If target fails, revert DNS to old server.

riskMatrix.dataLoss: LOW — backup + manual .env transfer + git remote
riskMatrix.downtime: LOW — old laptop continues serving during migration
riskMatrix.compatibility: LOW — Node.js is cross-platform, same Windows OS family
riskMatrix.secretExposure: MEDIUM — must ensure secure .env transfer channel
